title: Watercolor Painting: A Comprehensive Approach to Mastering the Medium
description: The beauty of a watercolor painting lies in its diaphanous layers, delicate strokes, and luminous washes. However, the very features that define the beauty of the medium can make it difficult to master. This complete guide to understanding the relationships between color, value, wetness, and composition unravels the mysteries of watercolor to help your practice evolve. Experienced teacher and acclaimed artist Tom Hoffmann offers a unique, inquiry-based approach that shows you how to translate any subject into the language of watercolor. With Hoffmann as your guide, you’ll learn the key questions to ask yourself at every turn and time-tested methods to help you reach solutions. Hoffmann’s thorough explanations and step-by-step demonstrations delineate the process of composing a painting in watercolor, while art from more than thirty-five past and present masters, including John Singer Sargent, Ogden Pleissner, George Post, Emil Kosa, Jr., Mary Whyte, Trevor Chamberlain, Lars Lerin, Torgeir Schjølberg, Piet Lap, Leslie Frontz, and Alvaro Castagnet serve to illustrate and inspire. Whether you’re a serious beginner or a seasoned practitioner, this book will guide you toward the all-important balance between restraint and risk-taking that every watercolorist seeks.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8"]', '#CardInstanceiSglfxxeyo72_UPO3FBeng')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dar

title: Color: A Course in Mastering the Art of Mixing Colors
description: Millions of people have learned to draw using the methods of Dr. Betty Edwards's bestseller The New Drawing on the Right Side of the Brain . Now, much as artists progress from drawing to painting, Edwards moves from black-and-white into color. This much-awaited new guide distills the enormous existing knowledge about color theory into a practical method of working with color to produce harmonious combinations. Using techniques tested and honed in her five-day intensive color workshops, Edwards provides a basic understanding of how to see color, how to use it, and-for those involved in art, painting, or design-how to mix and combine hues. Including more than 125 color images and exercises that move from simple to challenging, this volume explains how to: see what is really there rather than what you "know" in your mind about colored objects perceive how light affects color, and how colors affect one another manipulate hue, value, and intensity of color and transform colors into their opposites balance color in still-life, landscape, figure, and portrait painting understand the psychology of color harmonize color in your surroundings While we recognize and treasure the beautiful use of color, reproducing what we see can be a challenge. Accessibly unweaving color's complexity, this must-have primer is destined to be an instant classic.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_6"]', '#CardInstanceQb8Q2sADWkcyrncD2zmMcA')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_6',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-m

description: Learn how to use watercolor to soothe your soul with this beginner's guide to painting for relaxation. In this guide for the absolute beginner, artist and teacher Sharone Stevens makes the joy of watercolor accessible to everyone. With simple techniques and exercises, she shows how painting lines, patterns, and shapes can have a powerful meditative effect. Along the way, you will find yourself creating beautiful artwork that you'll be proud to display in your home. Watercolor painting can also help you connect with the world around you, finding inspiration in your every-day life and discovering the beautiful textures of nature. title: Watercolor Without Perfection: Landscapes: Step-by-Step Techniques, Simple Projects and Mi
description: Put down the leaves. You don't have to paint every tree, rock, or ripple to create a beautiful landscape. In fact, the less you try to control, the more your watercolor can come to life. Watercolor Without Perfection: Landscapes is all about loosening up, seeing the big picture, and letting the water do some of the work. Because you're already a painter. Now it's time to trust yourself. Inside, you'll learn to: Paint trees without worrying about every leaf Mix natural greens that actually look like they belong outside Create misty mountains, dreamy skies, and peaceful reflections Make landscapes feel miles deep with a few simple tricks Use everyday objects (yes, even that old gift card) to create texture Rescue those inevitable "well, that wasn't the plan" moments Shift your mindset from getting it right to enjoying what unfolds on the paper Then bring it all together with four step-by-step projects: misty mountains, a quiet lake at dusk, rolling fields, and a beautiful coastline. And finally, you'll bring everything you've learned together to paint a landscape that's entirely your own. Along the way, you'll explore changing seasons, shifting light, and finding your own style. No perfection required. No fancy supplies. No pressure to get it right. Just you, your paints, and the freedom to experiment, trust yourself, and discover your own style. And yes, the view from your kitchen window or the one only in your mind - absolutely counts. Grab your brush. Let's paint.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1"]', '#CardInstanceVgUz5tGW6eGVitejVoqfpg')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--a

title: A Year of Watercolour: A Seasonal Guide to Botanical Watercolour Painting
description: Create beautiful botanical artworks, engage with the natural world around you, and take pleasure in the changing seasons with A Year of Watercolour . Award-winning and bestselling artist and tutor Harriet de Winton takes you through more than 30 step-by-step botanical paintings that span the seasons. Learn to paint cherry blossoms and lambs in the spring, honeybees and wildflowers for summer, oak leaves and harvest mice in autumn, and pine trees and snowdrops in winter. Plus, enjoy charming bonus features like a recipe for wild garlic pesto in springtime, or guidance on how to paint a festive wreath with winter berries and foliage.
